name: infinitecampus-mcp
description: Infinite Campus (Campus Parent) MCP — single-account with CUPS auto-discovery. Two auth paths: IC_USERNAME/IC_PASSWORD, or sign in via the ContextMint Bridge browser extension.

ic_base_url.title: Portal base URL (https://...)
ic_base_url.description: Campus Parent portal base URL, e.g. https://campus.springfield.k12.example.us

ic_district.title: District app name
ic_district.description: Infinite Campus district app name (the appName path segment in the portal URL).

ic_username.title: Username (optional with ContextMint Bridge)
ic_username.description: Campus Parent portal username. Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser extension fallback — sign into your IC portal in the browser and the MCP captures the session cookies automatically.

ic_password.title: Password (optional with ContextMint Bridge)
ic_password.description: Campus Parent portal password. Required only when username is set. Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser extension fallback.

ic_name.title: Display name (optional)
ic_name.description: Friendly name for the district (e.g. "Springfield"). Defaults to the district app name if not set.

ic_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable ContextMint Bridge fallback (optional)
ic_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to 1 to skip the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).

ic_session_cache.title: On-disk session cache (optional)
ic_session_cache.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

ic_session_file.title: Session cache file (optional)
ic_session_file.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.infinitecampus-mcp/session-<district>.json.

ic_download_dir.title: Download directory (optional)
ic_download_dir.description: Absolute path of the only directory ic_download_document may write into. Defaults to ~/Downloads.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: ContextMint Bridge port (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: ContextMint Bridge bind host (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: ContextMint Bridge identity directory (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.
